purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for indexes, statistics freshness, optimizer plans, cache use, invalidation/rebuild state and execution performance evidence.

topics.name: DWH Query Performance Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for indexes, statistics freshness, optimizer plans, cache use, invalidation/rebuild state and execution performance evidence.

semantics.identity_rule: Query, plan, index, statistics set, cache entry, execution and source identities remain distinct.
semantics.semantic_rule: UI clearly distinguishes optimization strategy from canonical query meaning.
semantics.action_rule: collect-stats/rebuild-index/invalidate-cache/replan operations invoke separate authorized maintenance workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing/optimizing grants no data access or mutation authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Plan/index/cache dependency edges correspond only to explicit refs/evidence.
semantics.failure_rule: Stale stats, invalid indexes, stale caches and fallback plans are surfaced explicitly.

invariants.rule: Indexes, statistics, caches and optimizer plans may change execution strategy only; they never change canonical query semantics, data identity, ownership, classification or authorization.

hard_gates.condition: monitor shows plan as canonical query definition
index/cache identities conflated with source data
